# Contributing

Thank you for your interest in this project.

## Reporting a bug

If you want to report a bug or fix it, please [open an issue][report bug]
or create a pull request.

[report bug]: https://github.com/ile-24556/obsidian-plugin-smart-punctuation-on-rendering/issues/new?template=bug_report.md

## Requesting a new feature

If you want to introduce a new feature, please first [open an issue][request feature].

[request feature]: https://github.com/ile-24556/obsidian-plugin-smart-punctuation-on-rendering/issues/new?template=feature_request.md

## Developing

1. Clone the repository into the `.obsidian/plugins` of your test vault.
2. Run `npm install && npm prepare`.
3. Change the code.
4. Run `npm run build`.
5. Check the behavior on Obsidian.
6. Commit changes. Checks will be executed via pre-commit script.
